walk:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production transparent sprite sheet based on the attached APPROVED character concept. Preserve identity: green undead porter, huge yellow eyes, ragged olive cap, torn dark vest ochre trim, brown trousers, dangling green arms, heavy boots, giant RECTANGULAR BLACK crate with brass-gold corners strapped to back, three large gold-tipped BLACK ammunition rounds poking above crate, three-bullet gold emblem on crate, chunky black/gold chest ammo belt. NOT coins, no gun, no red tanks. Bright polished 2.5D cartoon with crisp dark outline, same slightly elevated fixed camera and top-left light.
Output actual transparent background PNG, 1536x1920 canvas, STRICT 4 columns x 5 rows, exactly20 equal384x384cells, ONE full body per cell, every character entirely inside its cell with ample blank gutters. No labels, headings, text, grid, floor, shadows, backdrop, effects, or detached objects.
Direction rows MUST differ anatomically: ROW1 S straight FRONT toward viewer, face/chest centered, crate BEHIND shoulders; ROW2 SE front-right threequarter facing down-right; ROW3 E exact RIGHT SIDE PROFILE looking screen-right, one eye, crate behind to screen-left; ROW4 NE back-right threequarter facing away upper-right, back crate dominates, face barely visible; ROW5 N full BACK facing away upward, only rear cap and back of crate, NO face or eyes. Do not rotate frontal image or camera.
All columns within each row hold exactly that angle and identical scale. Four clearly different keyframes of slow undead burdened WALK: col1 left foot makes a SHORT forward low step right toe trails; col2 left planted right foot drags past low, torso sinks; col3 right foot short forward low step left toe trails; col4 right planted left foot drags past low. Tiny boot clearance, no lifted knees, limp loose arms with small alternating swing, hunched spine and drooping head, crate lags subtly with weight. Feet must visibly ALTERNATE left and right across frames; don't duplicate same pose. Same physical proportions in all20 sprites, standing full body about300px tall, ground baseline at local y350 in every cell. Keep crate and all3 rounds consistent, shoulders always drooped, NO running, NO marching, NO fist pumping, NO high knees, NO heroic stance. This is the same approved character turned into animation assets.
actions:
Use case: identity-preserve. Make companion PRODUCTION ACTION SPRITE SHEET for the EXACT approved black-gold ammunition porter in references. Image1 approved concept; image2 walking identity + anatomical direction reference. Same green zombie, olive cap, black vest yellow trim, brown trousers, boots, chest black/gold ammo belt, wide black rectangular crate brass corners on BACK, 3 gold-tipped black rounds and triple-bullet emblem. Preserve recognizable cartoon game art, fixed slightly top-down camera, body scale, top-left lighting.
PNG with GENUINE ALPHA TRANSPARENT background. Canvas2304x1920, exactly SIX columns and FIVE rows of equal384x384 cells =30 full sprites. ALL sprites inside own cell with at least24px clear margin on every side, NO clipping, NO shadows, no ground, no labels, text, grid lines or effects floating between cells. Character roughly280px tall with soles at localy345. Keep same scale even when fallen, never enlarge cropped bodies.
ROWS fixed directions:1 SOUTH direct frontal symmetrical face/chest;2 SE front-right threequarter;3 EAST strict right side profile looking screen-right, single eye, box behind to left;4 NE BACK-right threequarter facing away top-right, mostly back box;5 NORTH full back, no face visible. Do not rotate front sprites. Every column in same row keeps the same viewing direction.
COLUMNS narrative:
1 IDLE PREPARE: deeply slumped but feet side by side planted, arms limp low.
2 SMALL HIT FLINCH: identical lower body/feet and both dangling arms as column1, ONLY head slightly tilts back and eyes squeeze if visible, tiny upper chest reaction; box stays attached CLOSED, 3 rounds remain.
3 RECOVER: identical lower body/feet/arms as col1, head returns down, same closed box.
4 BREAK: now knees give way, crouching slightly, shoulders sag, hinged box lid visibly FLIPS OPEN, ammo still in box; do not fly ammo out yet.
5 FALL: body loses support and tips sideways down into low collapse, box tilts with body and remains physically strapped, lid open.
6 REST: body lying collapsed low on side, boots and head visible in correct view, crate beside back and fully open, NO detached limbs. Motion ends here. No blood/gore.
Critical first3columns in everyrow: feet/legs and arms perfectly SAME fixed posture, do not shuffle or raise knees. Last3 columns true full-body collapse with obvious falling arc and lower final silhouette, not kneeling then standing again. Keep all ammo as gold pointed tip BLACK casing gold band. Keep three bullet icon on box without writing. This is an asset sheet, not concept presentation.
